reason: brief P3c (was P2j: the area mapping waited for the colour picker). The exposure slider's picker is desktop's spot exposure mapping (exposure.c color_picker_apply -> _auto_set_exposure; module action spot, engine-api.md 6.3). Its area mode and target lightness are interface-only on desktop (kept in darktable's configuration, darkroom/modules/exposure/lightness): the app keeps them as picker settings and passes them to the action; "measure" writes the measured lightness back as the target, as desktop does; a new target in "correction" mode applies the armed picker again (_spot_settings_changed_callback).

picker.label: set the exposure adjustment using the selected area
